newsitem.title: JAPAN: SHORT TRACK SPEED SKATING-CHAREST SETS MARK IN 500 METRES.
newsitem.headline: SHORT TRACK SPEED SKATING-CHAREST SETS MARK IN 500 METRES.

text.p: Canada's Isabelle Charest shaved 0.313 seconds off the women's 500-metre world record in a heat at the world short track speed skating championships on Saturday.
Charest finished in 44.867 seconds to record the first world record in the White Ring venue which will host short track events at next year's Nagano Olympics.
Yang Yang of China set the previous mark of 45.18 seconds last November in Beijing.
